rows.note: Unambiguous single-select, all visible fits radio_group.
Combobox best; native select is a common, defensible fallback.
20 items borderline; both listed options reasonable.
Feature comparison across named plans is the cards use case.
Segmented ideal on mobile; radio_group also defensible.
Persistent descriptions rule out select; not a feature comparison so not cards.
Native select is arguably safer for keyboard/SR a11y; should be admitted too.
No constraints, three options genuinely tied; low confidence appropriate.
Time-bounded phrasing implies temporary suspension, not disable_all.
Utterance unambiguous; single defensible reading, gold matches.
'Other' wrongly excludes plausible reads; gold's 3-way ambiguity set is reasonable.
Accent colour is trap: already 'reserved for primary,' adds weight; gold correctly excludes it.
